pageTitle: Georgia Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: Where to Buy Georgia Lottery Tickets?
items.answer:
Georgia Lottery tickets can be purchased from authorized retailers to persons 18 years and older.

 

Georgia Lottery Powerball and Georgia Lottery Mega Millions tickets and others can be purchased online or via the Georgia Lottery app.

 

You can also use the app to see if you’re one of the Georgia Lottery winners and to view the Georgia Lottery results.

items.question: What to Do If You Win the Georgia State Lottery?
items.answer: After viewing the results of the Georgia Lottery, you can claim prizes under $600 at your nearest retailer. Prizes over $600 can be collected at designated offices. Alternatively, winnings can be claimed via mail. Players have up to 180 days to redeem.

items.question: How Does the Second Chance Georgia Lottery Work?
items.answer: If you weren’t one of the Georgia Lottery winners, you can enter the non-winning ticket into one of the Georgia Lottery second chance promotions.
